verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. Rescue me from evil people, LORD. Keep me safe from violent people.
They’re planning harm deep down. They keep getting together to make war.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes. There’s viper venom under their lips. Selah.
LORD, keep me out of the grip of the wicked. Protect me from violent people set on tripping me up.
Proud people have hidden a trap for me. They’ve stretched a net by the path and laid snares for me. Selah.
I said to the LORD, “You’re my God.” LORD, listen when I cry for help.
LORD, my Lord, you’re the strength that saves me. You covered my head when battle came.
LORD, don’t give the wicked what they want. Don’t let their plans work, or they’ll get even prouder. Selah.
As for the people surrounding me, let the trouble they spoke come down on their own heads.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into fire, into muddy pits they’ll never climb out of.
People who speak evil won’t get a foothold in the land. Let trouble hunt down the violent and bring them down.
I know the LORD will stand up for people who are suffering and see that the needy get justice.
The righteous will thank you for your name. The upright will live in your presence.
